response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience, far exceeding the entry-level scope of this Junior Java Developer role. His expertise centers on TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and full-stack/systems work rather than Java specifically, and his German is only basic, falling short of the strong verbal/written German requirement for client-facing insurance sector work. He would almost certainly be overqualified, underpaid, and quickly disengaged in a junior-level position.
strengths: Extensive, proven software development experience across many domains and languages
Demonstrated agile/craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development)
Strong communication and teaching ability shown through talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: Vastly overqualified (Staff/Senior level) for an entry-level junior position
German is only 'Basic', not meeting the strong bilingual communication requirement
Limited recent hands-on Java experience; current stack is TypeScript/Node.js focused
